headline: Held dress code and student expression policies for further review; no policy changes made.
summary: The subcommittee reviewed draft policies under Section I and Section J. It decided to hold policy JIB for administrative review and to hold policy JICA, which covers dress code, until the administration gathers input from the whole school community. The subcommittee also approved minutes from the July 1, 2026 meeting 3-0.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the July 1, 2026 meeting, 3-0.
Held policy JIB for administrative review.
Held policy JICA on dress code for district-wide input before moving forward.

decision_evidence.quote: Member Keegan made a motion to approve the minutes for July 1,2026. ... VOTE: 3-0 Passed

WILL HOLD FOR DISTRICT WIDE INPUT the plan is for the administration to gage the opinion of the different constituencies and come back to us with feedback to move forward in the best interest of the students, families, and faculty.
